Name: Less Creepy Harvey
Author: CaliiQuasar
Description:
This mod makes Harvey a little less creepy by removing the parts of the game that suggest he is actually your doctor in addition to a marriage candidate. It changes four lines of dialogue, removes one entirely, and alters his 4-heart event. Expand the spoiler tag for a detailed list of changes.

[spoiler]
[size=3]Tuesday, 8 hearts, player unmarried
[/size]Original: Don't overwork yourself, [player name]. Doctor's orders! Your health is important to me. [blush-y face]
Altered: Don't overwork yourself, [player name]. Doctor's orders! Your health is important.

[size=3]Wednesday, 4 hearts
[/size]Original: I'd like to get to know you better, [player name]. Let's put aside our doctor-patient relationship.
Altered: I'd like to get to know you better, [player name]. Would you like to get coffee sometime?

[size=3]Thursday, 8 hearts, player unmarried[/size]
Original: It's a lot of work, being a doctor. I don't eat as well as I should. If I didn't live alone I think it would be easier.
Altered: It's a lot of work, being a doctor. I don't eat as well as I should.

[size=3]Friday, 10 hearts
[/size]Original: Stop by my place if you ever need a confidential check-up.
Altered: [removed entirely]

[size=3]4-heart Event
[/size]Rather than giving you a check-up, Harvey just confirms that he's gotten the paperwork from your doctor that will allow you to be treated at the Stardew Valley clinic in case of emergency. (you can also make it so the heart event doesn't play at all by editing the content.json file - see below)

[size=3]Luau, odd-numbered years
[/size]Original: Good thing I came with sunscreen. I wonder if Maru could use some sunscreen on her shoulders?
Altered: Good thing I came with sunscreen. I should probably check and make sure Maru brought some as well.
[/spoiler]


[size=5]Customization
[/size]If you want to revert to original dialogue/events, or maybe further tweak the changes I've made, you'll just need to edit the mod's "content.json" file. I've added general instructions for how to change most things to that file, but feel free to ask if you're not sure.

There is also an option in there to remove the 4-heart cutscene entirely instead of using the shorter version I made.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
Try checking the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Stardew Valley Wiki page on modding[/url] if you're having trouble!


[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Should work with Stardew Valley 1.6.x on Linux/macOS/Windows. Has been tested on Windows.
[*]May conflict with other mods that modify Harvey's dialogue. Please let me know if you find any specific conflicts.
[/list]

[size=5]Questions/requests?[/size]
Feel free to post or send me a message if you have any questions, requests, or whatever!
